verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a risk register: users can add NIST risk scenarios from a risk library, and Comply AI produces inherent risk scores, treatment, residual risk scores, and justifications. Risks are also exposed as managed objects via the MCP server. The evidence does not show risk owners, recurring risk review cycles, or risks linked to controls, so only about half the story is supported. Missing for 10: documented risk ownership assignment, risk review cycles or schedules, risk-to-control mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
